classification_scope: The frozen label applies only to the preregistered development-selection comparison against the same-view shallow probe; it is not an overall replacement or superiority claim.
reason: Frozen v1 has higher point-estimate recall (0.746032 vs 0.738095) and lower mean actual context (1147.619 vs 1199.206). The paired recall and token differences are not significant, and the v1/v2 nominal safety maxima differ.
